# Diplomatic action: transfer newly conquered non-capital locations in the same zone to an active Grand Protectorate.
oe_cel3_ci_grant_zone_lands = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_CHINA_ACTIONS
	ai_tick = daily
	ai_tick_frequency = 720
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		oe_cel_ai_enabled = yes
		oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		at_war = no
		any_subject = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
			has_variable = oe_cel3_zone_id
		}
	}

	potential = {
		exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_subject }
		visible = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject_of = scope:actor
			is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
			has_variable = oe_cel3_zone_id
		}
		enabled = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oe_cel3_ci_has_grantable_zone_lands_tt
				oe_cel3_actor_has_zone_lands_for_subject = yes
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:actor
				exists = scope:recipient
			}
			custom_tooltip = oe_cel3_ci_grant_zone_lands_tt
			scope:actor = {
				oe_cel3_grant_zone_lands_to_recipient = yes
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -5
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { NOT = { oe_cel_ai_enabled = yes } } }
			add = -1000
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { subject_loyalty >= 45 } }
			add = 35
		}
	}
}
